home.featuresTitle: Everything you need to pass, in one place
home.featuresSubtitle: Learning, practising, understanding your mistakes and knowing when to book the exam: every step has its tool.

features.exams: Mock exams true to the real one
features.examsText: Same duration, same number of questions and same rules as the real exam: timer, locked sections, case studies, Yes / No series and review screen. Every exam is different.
features.correctionText: Why the right answer is right, why every other option is wrong, and where to read more in {docsNames}.
features.courseText: Chapters split into sections, following the domains of the exam. Your reading is tracked, and some chapters are free.
features.quizText: A few questions to check a chapter before moving on, corrected as soon as you submit.
features.readinessText: Score per domain, bronze, silver or gold mastery, and an index that tells you when to book the exam.
features.motivationText: Exams and quizzes earn experience; badges reward regular practice and progress.
features.multiText: Prepare several at once: an overview brings them together, and one payment is enough for several Passes.

home.stepsTitle: From the first chapter to the real exam

steps.learnText: Read the course chapter by chapter and check each one with its quiz.
steps.practiceText: Take full mock exams, timed as on exam day.
steps.reviewText: The correction details every option, and your weak domains lead you to the right chapter.
steps.passText: When the index says “Ready”, book the exam, then report your result: it makes the index more reliable for everyone.

faq.dumpsQ: Do the questions come from the real exam?
faq.dumpsA: No. Every question is original, written from the public documentation of {vendors} and reviewed before publication. None comes from a real exam: learning answers by heart does not prepare you, understanding does.
faq.scoreQ: Is the score comparable to the exam's?
faq.scoreA: Each mock exam uses the scale, the pass mark and the domain weights of the real exam. It is an indicator of readiness, not a guaranteed prediction of the result.
faq.languagesA: Yes, for every certification. The interface is in English and French; questions and course also exist in French when the official exam is offered in French. Certifications offered in English only, such as the Kubernetes ones, are marked as such.
faq.resumeQ: What if I close the page during an exam?
faq.resumeA: Your answers are saved as you go. You pick up where you left off; the timer, however, keeps running, as on exam day.
faq.freeA: {exams}, your score per domain, the correction of the questions you missed, the free chapters of the course with their quizzes and progress tracking. Full access adds unlimited exams, the explanation of every option and the whole course.
faq.severalQ: Can I prepare for several certifications?
faq.severalA: Yes. The Pass is bought per certification, and several Passes can be paid in a single payment. Your dashboard then brings all your certifications together, each with its readiness and level.

home.finalTitle: Ready to measure yourself against the exam?

privacy.title: Privacy policy

controller.title: Data controller
body: The controller of the personal data collected on Certidrill is Square-soft (a SARL currently being registered), 4 rue Saint-Michel, 78430 Louveciennes, France.
For any question or to exercise your rights: contact@certidrill.com.

data.title: Data collected
body: Account: e-mail address, password (only its hash is kept, never the password itself), chosen language, dates the account was created and verified.
Practice: mock exams and practice sessions (questions drawn, answers, scores), course sections read, questions reported and real exam results you declare.
Payments: amount, currency, status and certification of each Pass bought, country and VAT number given at payment. Card details are entered at Stripe and never go through our servers.

Sign-ins: date, type (password, sign-in link, wrong password, sign-in blocked after too many tries, password change) and full IP address. A sign-in attempt on your account is recorded on your account, with the IP address of whoever made it, even if it was not you. An e-mail address without an account typed at sign-in is not recorded.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal bases
body: Providing the service (account, exams, course, Passes): performance of the contract.
Taking payments and keeping the accounts: performance of the contract and legal obligations.
Protecting accounts (detecting intrusion attempts) and following the site's activity (visits, exams taken, sales): the publisher's legitimate interest.

recipients.title: Recipients
body: The data is only accessible to Certidrill's administrators. Sign-ins and their IP addresses are visible to them only.

When an account is created, its e-mail address, language and date are sent by e-mail to Certidrill's administrators (a sign-up notice, sent through Brevo), to follow sign-ups: the publisher's legitimate interest.

Processors: Stripe (payments), IONOS (server hosting, in the European Union) and Brevo (e-mail sending, in the European Union). Stripe may process some data in the United States, under the safeguards provided by the GDPR (the European Commission's standard contractual clauses). No data is sold or used for advertising.

retention.title: Retention periods
body: Account and practice: as long as the account exists; they are deleted with it.
Sign-ins: one year, then deleted automatically; they also go with the account.
Payments: kept for accounting obligations, detached from your account when it is deleted. The customer created at Stripe is then deleted at Stripe.
Sign-in and sign-up confirmation links: until they expire.

rights.title: Your rights
body: You can ask for access to your data, its rectification, erasure or portability, or the restriction of its processing, and object to processing based on legitimate interest, by writing to the contact address above.
You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr), the French data protection authority.

cookies.title: Cookies
body: Certidrill only uses cookies needed for it to work: the sign-in session and the display language. No audience measurement or advertising cookies.

body: These terms of sale govern the sale of Certidrill Passes on certidrill.com to consumers, in France and abroad. They are a translation: the French version prevails.

Every order means acceptance of the terms in force on its date, which the buyer accepts expressly before paying.

service.title: The Pass
body: A Pass gives, for one certification and for the length shown at purchase (90 days unless stated otherwise), full access to Certidrill: unlimited practice exams, a detailed correction of every question, the full course and progress tracking.
Without a Pass, free access remains available with its limits, described on the Pricing page.

Certidrill is an independent practice tool. It is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by Microsoft, Amazon Web Services (AWS), The Linux Foundation or the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), gives no access to the official exams and does not guarantee passing them.

account.title: Account
body: Buying needs a Certidrill account with a confirmed e-mail address. The Pass is personal: the account must not be shared.
In case of clear abuse (account sharing, automated extraction of the content), Square-soft may suspend access after informing the user.

price.title: Prices
body: Prices are shown in euros on the Pricing page and again before payment. The price that applies is the one shown when ordering.
VAT not applicable, art. 293 B of the French General Tax Code: Square-soft is under the French VAT franchise scheme, so prices are net, without VAT.
Any currency conversion or bank fees of the buyer, notably outside the euro area, remain the buyer's.

order.title: Order and payment
body: The buyer chooses one or more certifications, ticks the box accepting the terms and waiving the right of withdrawal, then pays by card on Stripe's secure payment page. Square-soft never sees the card details.
The order is final once Stripe confirms the payment. A confirmation e-mail is then sent; it restates the purchase and the consent given on withdrawal. The invoice is available in My account, Billing.

access.title: Start and length of access
body: The Pass starts as soon as the payment is confirmed. Bought while a Pass is running on the same certification, it starts when that one ends: no day is lost.
When the Pass ends, access becomes free again. Scores, history and progress are kept. An e-mail warns seven days before the end.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
body: Consumers normally have 14 days to withdraw from a distance contract. This right does not apply to digital content not supplied on a tangible medium whose supply has begun with the consumer's prior express consent and acknowledgement that they thereby lose their right of withdrawal (French Consumer Code, article L221-28, 13°, implementing Directive 2011/83/EU).

As the Pass is supplied upon payment, before paying the buyer asks for immediate access and expressly waives the right of withdrawal by ticking a dedicated box. Without this consent, no purchase is possible. The consent, its date and the text accepted are kept with the payment and restated in the confirmation e-mail.
Consequently, a Pass bought cannot be refunded, except where the law provides (legal guarantee of conformity below).

conformity.title: Legal guarantee of conformity
body: Square-soft must supply digital content in conformity with the contract (French Consumer Code, articles L224-25-1 and following). In case of non-conformity, the consumer may have it brought into conformity or, failing that, obtain a price reduction or end the contract.
To report a defect, write to contact@certidrill.com describing the problem. A mistake in a question can also be reported from the question itself.

availability.title: Availability and liability
body: Square-soft strives to keep the site available at all times without being able to guarantee it: interruptions for maintenance or incidents remain possible.
The content is written carefully to prepare for the exam. The result of the official exam depends on the candidate and on the certification's publisher: Square-soft cannot be held liable for it.

data.title: Personal data
body: The data needed for the order is processed by Square-soft and its processors (including Stripe for payment), as the privacy policy describes.

mediation.title: Complaints and mediation
body: Any complaint can be sent to contact@certidrill.com.

Failing an amicable solution, the consumer may refer the matter free of charge to the consumer mediator Square-soft belongs to: [name, postal address and website of the consumer mediator], within one year of their written complaint.

Failing an amicable agreement, the dispute goes before the competent court under the legal rules; the consumer may bring it before the courts of their place of residence.
